title: MissingMoebTool signals not emitted for Read and ToolSearch in fix_signal run
description: Used Claude Code native Read tool to read oversized fix_signal output file and ToolSearch to load deferred moeb tool schemas, without emitting MissingMoebTool signals after each call, causing moeb-tool-origin to fail.
proposed_resolution: Emit MissingMoebTool signals immediately after each external tool call, or address root cause: provide a moeb tool that reads oversized output files, and embed moeb tool schemas in the fix_signal prompt to eliminate ToolSearch.
